summary: Added a letter-digit boundary regex to normalizeIndexName so index names that niftyindices and indiapassivefunds spell with different spacing around a number (e.g. "MIDSMALLCAP400" vs "MidSmallcap 400") still match.
reason: index funds / index tracking / index cheapest-tracker incorrectly reported that indiapassivefunds does not enumerate NIFTY MIDSMALLCAP400 MOMENTUM QUALITY 100, even though the taxonomy entry exists (as "Nifty MidSmallcap 400 Momentum Quality 100 TRI"), purely because of a spacing mismatch in the two sites' naming.
validated_outcome: Fix returns 2 tracking funds for the affected index; regression-checked NIFTY 50 (47 funds) and NIFTY ALPHA 50 (4 funds) unchanged; added TestNormalizeIndexName and a TestFindUnderlyingIndexValue subtest.
